title: Kanda 18: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 18.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 18.

verses.original: ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासः अनूहिरे पथिभी राजयानैः । तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु सुकृतं लोके ॥
verses.transliteration: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ anūhire pathibhī rājayānaiḥ | tebhyo namo astu sukṛtaṁ loke ||
verses.translation: Those noble ancestors of ours who traversed the royal path of righteousness — to them be salutations in the realm of the blessed!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Pitri hymn: gratitude and reverent continuity with the ancestors who preserved knowledge and virtue.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: Those noble ancestors of ours who traversed the royal path of righteousness — to them be salutations in the realm of the blessed!

layers.content: अथर्ववेद काण्ड 18: The Pitri hymn: gratitude and reverent continuity with the ancestors who preserved knowledge and virtue.
